\* Uncertainty U is the expanded uncertainty (coverage factor k = 2, corresponding to a confidence level of approximately 95%) and was calculated in accordance with the Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement (GUM) [1] ## End of Validity The validity of this certificate ends 6 months after shipment of the material. Date of shipment: ## Material Description The material BAM-K001 is a solution of ethanol in water, produced by gravimetric single-bottle dosing in units of approximately 4 liters. The solution is contained in a brown glass bottle with a screw cap according to DIN 45, equipped with a Teflon septum. The starting material used was ethanol absolute (≥ 99.8%) and water of quality grade 2 (DIN ISO 3696). ## Recommended Use The reference material is intended for the periodic calibration of breath alcohol analyzers in accordance with DIN VDE 0405-4 [1] and for applications according to the international recommendation OIML-R126 [2]. In addition, it can be used for the validation of analytical methods for the determination of ethanol in water. ## Handling When used in Evidential Breath Analysers the requirements of the relevant regulations must be observed.
